ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: If point $E$ is the midpoint of $BC$, and $CD=4$, by folding the square $ABCD$ along $FH$ such that point $D$ precisely falls on the midpoint $E$ of side $BC$, and the corresponding point of point $A$ is point $P$, then what is the length of the crease $HF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}

Draw $HG \perp CD$ at point G, and connect $DE$, as shown in the diagram:\\
Then, $\angle DGH=\angle FGH=90^\circ$,\\
In the square $ABCD$, $\angle A=\angle D=\angle C=90^\circ$, $AD=CD=BC=4$,\\
$\therefore$ Quadrilateral $ADGH$ is a rectangle,\\
$\therefore GH=AD=CD$,\\
According to the folding, $FH$ is a perpendicular bisector of $DE$,\\
$\therefore \angle FDE+\angle DFH=90^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle FDE+\angle DEC=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle DFH=\angle DEC$,\\
In $\triangle HGF$ and $\triangle DCE$,\\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle DFH=\angle DEC\\
\angle FGH=\angle ECD\\
HG=CD
\end{array}\right.$\\
$\therefore \triangle HGF \cong \triangle DCE \left(AAS\right)$,\\
$\therefore FH=DE$,\\
$\because E$ is the midpoint of $BC$,\\
$\therefore EC=2$,\\
In $Rt\triangle CDE$, according to the Pythagorean theorem, $DE=\sqrt{4^2+2^2}=2\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore FH=\boxed{2\sqrt{5}}$.

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中显示正方形ABCD的折叠示意，D在左上、A在左下，C在右上、B在右下；左侧AD以及到F、H的水平部分用虚线表示原正方形位置。E在右边BC上，F在上边DC上，H在下边AB上，线段FH是折痕；折叠后D落到E，A的对应点为P。推理：已知CD=4，所以正方形边长BC=AD=4。E是BC的中点，因此EC=2。按方法作DE，并过H作HG垂直于CD，垂足为G。因为H在AB上、G在CD上，且AD也垂直于AB和CD，所以ADGH为矩形，从而HG=AD=4=CD。折叠使D落到E，所以折痕FH是DE的垂直平分线，因此FH垂直DE。由垂直关系可得角FDE+角DFH=90度；又因为三角形DCE是直角三角形，角FDE与角CDE对应，所以角FDE+角DEC=90度，因此角DFH=角DEC。又角FGH和角ECD都是直角，并且HG=CD，所以三角形HGF与三角形DCE由AAS全等。于是HF=DE。最后在直角三角形DCE中，DC=4，CE=2，所以DE=sqrt(4^2+2^2)=sqrt(20)=2sqrt(5)。因此HF=2sqrt(5)。

Since folding D onto E means the crease FH is the perpendicular bisector of DE, compute the perpendicular bisector of D(0,4) and E(4,2). The midpoint of DE is M=(2,3), and DE has slope -1/2, so the crease has slope 2 and equation y-3=2(x-2), i.e. y=2x-1. method.CoT_answer_check_final: 图像描述：图中是正方形 ABCD 的折叠示意，A 在左下，B 在右下，C 在右上，D 在左上；右边 BC 为竖直边，E 标在 BC 上且位于中点位置；折痕为线段 FH，其中 F 在上边 DC 上，H 在下边 AB 上；D 折到 E，A 的对应点为 P。推理：按图中方向建立坐标系，令 A=(0,0), B=(4,0), C=(4,4), D=(0,4)。因为 E 是 BC 的中点，所以 E=(4,2)。折叠使 D 落到 E，因此折痕 FH 是线段 DE 的垂直平分线。DE 的中点 M=((0+4)/2,(4+2)/2)=(2,3)，DE 的斜率为 (2-4)/(4-0)=-1/2，所以垂直平分线 FH 的斜率为 2。过 M 的方程为 y-3=2(x-2)，即 y=2x-1。与 AB，即 y=0，相交得 x=1/2，所以 H=(1/2,0)。与 DC，即 y=4，相交得 x=5/2，所以 F=(5/2,4)。因此 HF=sqrt((5/2-1/2)^2+(4-0)^2)=sqrt(2^2+4^2)=sqrt(20)=2√5。

raw_record.original_question: If point $E$ is the midpoint of $BC$, and $CD=4$, by folding the square $ABCD$ along $FH$ such that point $D$ precisely falls on the midpoint $E$ of side $BC$, and the corresponding point of point $A$ is point $P$, then what is the length of the crease $HF$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:}

Draw $HG \perp CD$ at point $G$, and connect $DE$, as shown in the diagram:\\
Then, $\angle DGH=\angle FGH=90^\circ$,\\
In the square $ABCD$, $\angle A=\angle D=\angle C=90^\circ$, $AD=CD=BC=4$,\\
$\therefore$ quadrilateral $ADGH$ is a rectangle,\\
$\therefore GH=AD=CD$,\\
According to the folding, $FH$ is a perpendicular bisector of $DE$,\\
$\therefore \angle FDE+\angle DFH=90^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle FDE+\angle DEC=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle DFH=\angle DEC$,\\
In $\triangle HGF$ and $\triangle DCE$,\\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle DFH=\angle DEC\\
\angle FGH=\angle ECD\\
HG=CD
\end{array}\right.$\\
$\therefore \triangle HGF \cong \triangle DCE\ (AAS)$,\\
$\therefore FH=DE$,\\
$\because E$ is the midpoint of $BC$,\\
$\therefore EC=2$,\\
In right triangle $CDE$, according to the Pythagorean theorem, $DE=\sqrt{4^2+2^2}=2\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore FH=2\sqrt{5}$.
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a folding diagram of square ABCD, with D at the upper left, A at the lower left, C at the upper right, and B at the lower right; the left side AD and the horizontal parts to F and H are represented by dashed lines to indicate the original square position. E is on the right side BC, F is on the upper side DC, H is on the lower side AB, and segment FH is the crease; after folding, D lands on E, and the corresponding point of A is P. Reasoning: It is known that CD=4, so the side length of the square BC=AD=4. E is the midpoint of BC, therefore EC=2. Construct DE according to the method, and through H construct HG perpendicular to CD, with foot G. Because H is on AB, G is on CD, and AD is also perpendicular to AB and CD, ADGH is a rectangle, hence HG=AD=4=CD. The folding makes D land on E, so the crease FH is the perpendicular bisector of DE, therefore FH is perpendicular to DE. From the perpendicular relationship, angle FDE + angle DFH = 90 degrees; also because triangle DCE is a right triangle, angle FDE corresponds to angle CDE, so angle FDE + angle DEC = 90 degrees, therefore angle DFH = angle DEC. Also angle FGH and angle ECD are both right angles, and HG=CD, so triangle HGF and triangle DCE are congruent by AAS. Thus HF=DE. Finally, in right triangle DCE, DC=4, CE=2, so DE=sqrt(4^2+2^2)=sqrt(20)=2sqrt(5). Therefore HF=2sqrt(5).
